in_english.name: Fatiriyyah
in_english.meaning: One who is content with Allah's decree, modest, and successful

data.cultural_impact: The name Fatiriyyah carries a profound cultural significance in the Islamic world. It signifies the belief in the unity and supremacy of God as the Creator of all things. This notion is deeply embedded in the Islamic faith, emphasizing the central role of God in the universe. The name Fatiriyyah can also be associated with various Islamic concepts such as 'Tawheed', which refers to the belief in the oneness of God, and 'Khalaq', which signifies the attribute of God as the Creator.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fatiriyyah highlights the central role of God as the Creator and Sustainer of all life. Muslims believe that everything in the universe is an expression of God's creation, and the name Fatiriyyah serves as a reminder of the divine power and limitless capabilities of God. It also signifies a sense of humility and gratitude towards God, inspiring us to reflect upon the miraculous nature of creation and the blessings that we receive daily. Overall, Fatiriyyah is a name that invokes a deep sense of reverence and awe for the divine power and wisdom of God.
